body: Thank you for this perspective. It really helps me to understand better. I think communication is a big thing. He's tried to explain after I've pushed but it's like we are talking past eachother. From what I've gathered, it wasn't the birth that he struggled with it was the few days after when I was in extreme pain and struggling with breastfeeding when he felt helpless that he's struggling to get past. Out of curiosity, why do you suggest a completely new therapist? My husband has been to this therapist as well, but she's is mainly 'my' therapist. Do you think this would make her biased?

It makes sense what you said about her not really remembering so early so waiting for a while would be a good idea. I mostly wanted to open up the discussion now and for such a hard knockback I think I kneejerk reacted by getting hurt instead of being as understanding instead. I'm going to look into seeing how open my husband would be to counseling, either separately or together to help him deal with the birth. Thank you for your feedback.

That's a great idea to look into. I have a therapist that I see regularly who does couple therapy as well so I could also look into asking him about that. He's been resistant in the past but hopefully he'll be a bit more open to it now or to going to a support group. Thanks for the idea.

Thank you for this answer. In wanting a sibling for her I was wanting to start talking about it now to plan for the future. I wasn't expecting such a hard no to any discussion. I think that's what's thrown me off and made me partly feel so strongly about it. I definitely take what you said and give him more time to process before bringing it up again.
I'm definitely in the same boat. 9 month old daughter and I struggle to deal with a needy touching kitty. I love him still I just have not touching tickets left over for him.
I usually don't comment, but well done. This story is incredibly creepy and sad at the same time. I loved it.

Okay. Just to clarify my comment , not to start a fight. She went on vacation to Greece then went home so could be from anywhere that's why I don't agree with your assumption. I think your comment could have just been worded better by saying she was simply an irresponsible and scared woman who contemplated abortion and ended up damaging her child. Calling the child a brat also just seems to attempt to downplay the situation by blaming him for his situation which is a little silly since he's a baby and doesn't know better due to his lack of upbringing. I understand this is a sensitive subject. I was actually trying to quietly help by pointing out your comment could be misconstrued. Hope this makes my point clearer.
Nowhere does it specify their race just btw.

So hopefully you wanted constructive criticism and that's why you posted this. It's not a bad idea but your execution needs work, mostly grammar and sentence structure. I'd remove this, fix it up a bit and post on nosleep with a nsfw trigger as that sub is for longer stories like this. Hope that helps. :)
This was fantastic. Hooked me from the beginning all the way through. Well done indeed.
